title: Ontario Competitive Mathematics Committee
text:
The Ontario Competitive Mathematics Committee (OCMC) is Canada’s premier student-run nonprofit organization dedicated to encouraging and helping high school students across Ontario to prepare them for future national and international competitive math contests. Led by a team of enthusiastic students with a deep passion for math, the OCMC hosts its semiannual contests and summer training camp to provide unique opportunities for high school students to become more experienced with the environment of official math competitions.

Some contests it has:

Ontario Mathematics Competition

Ontario Invitational Mathematics Examination

Tesseract Mathematics Challenge
